An existing closed category taxonomy, INTENT_KINDS (schedule.py:58-86: 睡眠/晨间例程/通勤/工作/用餐/休息/娱乐/社交/家务/运动/外出), already tags day-plan goals in 待办层 (prompt_schemas.py:164-181). 进度层 already has a day-scoped 'progress-today' piece: rejected_today, read from local midnight with cross-session dedup (progress_layer.py:316-347). The owner's progress-today could extend this mechanism instead of widening the session bound.

The midnight planner is the de facto daily consumer of yesterday's memory (收尾记录 includes 想记住的), but it never reads memory_updated or reflections (day_plan_inputs.py:77-80). The reflection for day D is written about 8h after plan_day for D+1, so a compaction design must fix whether plan_day reads the compacted paragraph or keeps re-reading the full raw history every midnight.

The rolling subjective summary is overwritten, not accumulated. The final value is 272 chars describing only the last evening (state.json; life_memory.py:248-261). Today's only 'compaction' therefore destroys history. The owner's per-day paragraph needs an append-only dated record, which also needs an event payload, since memory_updated stores only hashes of the summary (memory_evidence.py:49-80).

Notes are filed by the session where the conclude request happened, not where the activity took place. Travel conclusions land in the arrival stay's entry (memory_layer.py:283-296; the final snapshot's transit entries have 0 self_notes). Per-round or per-category keying must use the activity's own time and session, not the request's.

Cold start and branches: the first run day has no earlier days, and reflection is skipped when the store is empty (life_memory.py:169-171). No reflection follows the final night. A 3-day tier will be empty or partial for the first 3 days of every run and counterfactual branch.

The verified-experience window (≤5 facts per observation, life_agent.py:494-507; life_memory.py:145-160) feeds only MEMORY.md and causes the 153 refresh_summary events. It is a second fact channel the redesign should either drop or reuse.

Category signals in catalog data are uneven. Goods `category` covers only 零食/食品/饮料/商品 (see the SUPPLY_NOT_FOUND messages), location `kind` covers 14 locations, and completion_effects appears on only 2 of 1368 content rows (input/catalog census). Deterministic category derivation will need a new catalog field, not existing data alone.
